name: ring muscle-up
description: A ring muscle-up that links a pull from the hang, a transition through the rings and a press to straight-arm support.
instructions: Hang from two rings with a secure grip and straight arms.
Pull the rings toward your chest while keeping them close to your body.
Lean your chest forward between the rings and bring your elbows above your hands to enter the dip position.
Press down on the rings to straight-arm support, then lower through the same path with control.
